mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recording_analysis_outbox ( command_id, event_type, job_id, case_id, recording_id, camera_id, camera_code, camera_name, recording_object_key, prompt, exclusion_prompt, similarity_threshold, search_start, search_end, search_area, attempt, occurred_at, status, retry_count, next_attempt_at ) VALUES ( #{commandId}, #{eventType}, #{jobId}, #{caseId}, #{recordingId}, #{cameraId}, #{cameraCode}, #{cameraName}, #{recordingObjectKey}, #{prompt}, #{exclusionPrompt}, #{similarityThreshold}, #{searchStart,typeHandler=com.ssafy.eyesonu.common.persistence.mybatis.UtcInstantTypeHandler}, #{searchEnd,typeHandler=com.ssafy.eyesonu.common.persistence.mybatis.UtcInstantTypeHandler}, #{searchArea}, #{attempt}, #{occurredAt,typeHandler=com.ssafy.eyesonu.common.persistence.mybatis.UtcInstantTypeHandler}, 'PENDING', 0, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) )
mapper.select: SELECT id, command_id, event_type, job_id, case_id, recording_id, camera_id, camera_code, camera_name, recording_object_key, prompt, exclusion_prompt, similarity_threshold, search_start, search_end, search_area, attempt, occurred_at, retry_count FROM recording_analysis_outbox WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING') AND next_attempt_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE recording_analysis_outbox SET status = 'PROCESSING', claim_token = #{claimToken}, next_attempt_at = #{leaseUntil,typeHandler=com.ssafy.eyesonu.common.persistence.mybatis.UtcInstantTypeHandler} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING') AND next_attempt_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)

UPDATE recording_analysis_outbox SET status = 'PENDING', claim_token = NULL, retry_count = retry_count + 1, last_error = LEFT(#{errorMessage}, 1000), next_attempt_at = DATE_ADD( UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL LEAST(POW(2, retry_count), 300) SECOND ) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND claim_token = #{claimToken}
